title: Your Personal Taxi
cast: Cha Tae Hyun, Im Se Mi, Joo Jong Hyuk
summary: A healing music drama about taxi driver Go Myung Seok, whose unusual cab carries passengers with everyday lives and extraordinary stories. Each journey is accompanied by a song chosen by the passenger.
whyFans: The taxi format lets each passenger's story and meaningful song become a small emotional portrait.
A recurring driver creates a steady centre for stories about very different lives.
The healing tone offers an alternative to plot-heavy thrillers.
review: Your Personal Taxi has an appealing simple device: passengers share parts of their lives through a ride and songs tied to their memories. That structure can make the show feel like a collection of small emotional portraits, while the recurring driver gives the season a steady centre. It is a good fit for viewers who enjoy reflective character stories.
